meta.title: The Division 2 – Exotics
meta.subtitle: By Tuxedo Bandido  ·  Last verified Sep 28, 2026 (live through TU Y8S3.1)  ·  79 live (45 weapons · 34 gear) + 2 announced/TBC  ·  Got column: File → Make a copy to tick checkboxes (published view is read-only)

exotics.name: St. Elmo's Engine
exotics.summary: Hits build stacks; at 100 stacks the next magazine is filled with Shock ammo.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Strega
exotics.summary: Kills mark every enemy within 20m (max 5 marks per enemy). +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Capacitor
exotics.summary: Hits build up to 40 stacks of +1.5% Skill Damage (decay after 5s). +7.5% Weapon Damage per Skill Tier.
exotics.obtain: Complete challenges in The Summit to get your first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Black Tusk Kill Squad (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint from Inaya unlocks targeted loot

exotics.name: Eagle Bearer
exotics.summary: Accuracy rises while firing (up to +30%). Headshot kills grant Tenacity for 15s: part of incoming damage is delayed, and kills reduce the delayed damage.
exotics.obtain: Complete the Dark Hours raid weekly on all your available characters

exotics.name: Chameleon
exotics.summary: 30 headshots: +20% CHC & +50% CHD. 65 body shots: +90% Weapon Damage. 20 leg shots: +150% Reload Speed. Each lasts 45s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: The Bighorn
exotics.summary: Scoped: switches to semi-auto dealing 450% weapon damage per shot. Headshots stack +6% Headshot Damage (max 25).
exotics.obtain: Named bosses in Strongholds / Summit boss floors on Legendary difficulty, or Dark Zone extraction

exotics.name: Agitator
exotics.summary: Holstered: -50% threat; primes after 10s holstered. Swapping to it when primed: +25% RPM, +30% Weapon Damage, +100% threat for 20s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Hyenas Retaliation completion (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)

exotics.name: Caduceus
exotics.summary: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's damage.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Assault Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit). Added to targeted loot in Y8S3; originally the Y8S2 Into the Dark Season Pass reward
exotics.targeted: Yes (added to targeted loot in Y8S3)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Cleaners Kill Squad (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)

exotics.name: Ouroboros
exotics.summary: In combat, when a status effect is on you, 50% of your next magazine applies that same status effect to targets.
exotics.obtain: Play the Paradise Lost Incursion weekly on all your available characters

exotics.name: Oxpecker
exotics.summary: While a Shield is deployed it loses 10% health/s, but gets repairs equal to 25% of this weapon's damage.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Sub Machine Gun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Lady Death
exotics.summary: Moving builds stacks (4/s, 8/s sprinting, max 30). Each round consumes one for +75% amplified damage. Kills grant +20% Movement Speed for 10s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Sub Machine Gun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Backfire
exotics.summary: Damage adds +2% CHD stacks (max 100, 10s). Reloading bleeds you for 0.5% armor per stack.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Sub Machine Gun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: The Chatterbox
exotics.summary: On reload, +25% RPM per enemy within 15m (max 5) for that magazine. Kills refill 50% of the magazine.
exotics.obtain: Complete its exotic quest to get your first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Sub Machine Gun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Underboss
exotics.summary: Hits mark one enemy at a time. +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies, +5% per extra Underboss mark from other agents (max 4 marks). PvP: +18%/+2%.
exotics.obtain: Y8 Season 2 (Into the Dark) Manhunt Climax Mission (Tens Nightclub: Zodiac). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty; lower chance on other difficulties
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Black Tusk Kill Squad (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)
exotics.added: Y8S2 Into the Dark (Climax from Aug 11, 2026)

exotics.name: Pestilence
exotics.summary: Hits apply a stacking DoT (100% weapon damage over 10s, max 50 stacks). When the enemy dies, stacks jump to an enemy within 25m.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Bluescreen
exotics.summary: Hits mark enemies and build up to 50 stacks. Deploying a non-shield skill consumes them to Pulse, Disrupt and Disorient marked targets (stronger with more stacks).
exotics.obtain: Complete the Captain Lewis Manhunt to get the blueprint. Then targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Bullet King
exotics.summary: Never needs reloading. Every 100 hits refills some reserve ammo for you and allies.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Iron Lung
exotics.summary: Firing fills a heat meter (50% of base mag size). When it's full, rounds ignite enemies. Reloading or swapping empties it.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Pakhan
exotics.summary: Each kill grants +75% Magazine Size to the next magazine (max 4 stacks).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Big Alejandro
exotics.summary: Each bullet fired from cover: +1% WD (max 100%) for 15s. Kills in cover refresh it; reloading, swapping or leaving combat cancels it.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Light Machinegun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit). Was a 10th Anniversary Event Pass reward (Tier 46)

exotics.name: Vertigo
exotics.summary: Suppressing an enemy applies Disorient and gives you and allies +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s. GR9 variant.
exotics.obtain: Red Moon Rising event (Sep 24 - Nov 3, 2026): random drop from the XB-35 "Phoebe" Marauder in the active PvE Dark Zone

exotics.name: Vindicator
exotics.summary: While scoped, highlights a random body section on each enemy. +75% Weapon Damage to highlighted sections.
exotics.obtain: Guaranteed purchase from the Descent vendor for 350 NSA Credits
exotics.notes: Earn credits from Descent Game Mode

exotics.name: Doctor Home
exotics.summary: Hits mark enemies for 5s. Killing a marked target gives the group a 10% armor repair (no bonus armor).
exotics.obtain: Complete the General Anderson Manhunt to get the blueprint. Then targeted loot: Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: The Ravenous
exotics.summary: Fires both barrels. Right-shoulder hits add offensive primers, left-shoulder hits add defensive primers; the other shoulder detonates them (damage, or bonus armor & armor-plate damage).
exotics.obtain: Complete the Iron Horse raid weekly on all your available characters

exotics.name: Diamondback
exotics.summary: Marks a random enemy within 20m. Hitting it guarantees a crit amplified by 20%, then all shots crit for 5s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Merciless
exotics.summary: Fires on trigger pull and release. Double hits build stacks; at 7 the next hit deals +500% and a 7m explosion. Convertible to Ruthless via blueprint.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Hyenas Kill Squad (Retaliation); Convert to Ruthless at crafting station

exotics.name: Bittersweet
exotics.summary: Headshots build up to 8 stacks. Shooting an ally/skill repairs them for 50% of shot damage per stack and grants bonus armor. At max stacks, healing makes all hits headshots for 8s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Steel & Sons ACR
exotics.summary: Body shots stack on the target (max 4, +4% Amplified Damage each). The next headshot consumes the stacks for +11% Amplified per stack. Breaking a weak point = +30% Amplified Damage from you for 5s.
exotics.obtain: Broken Rain Incursion: 1 roll per character per week from the final chest, plus a chance from bosses on repeat clears
exotics.blueprint: Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3.1)

exotics.name: Scorpio
exotics.summary: Hits stack venom: 2 = Poison, 4 = Disorient, 6 = Shock, 9 = target takes +20% damage from all sources.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Shotgun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Sheriff
exotics.summary: +35% Weapon Damage, +100% Accuracy, no damage drop-off (built into base stats).
exotics.obtain: Y7 Season 3 (Mutiny) Manhunt Climax Mission (United Ironworks: General Anderson). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)

exotics.name: Overlord
exotics.summary: Each pellet hit applies -4% Movement Speed to the enemy for 5s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Shotgun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Sweet Dreams
exotics.summary: Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies (15s cooldown), per wiki [verify full text]. Convertible to Lullaby via blueprint.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Shotgun (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Outcasts Kill Squad (Retaliation); Convert to Lullaby at crafting station

exotics.name: Fafnir
exotics.summary: Dragon's Breath shells: each shot has a 40% chance to apply Burn. Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.
exotics.obtain: Y8S3 Red Horizon Season Pass: free track tier 69, or premium tier 1 (premium has an extra copy)
exotics.targeted: Not yet (Y8S3 Season Pass; expected in loot pool after season)

exotics.name: Mantis
exotics.summary: Scope shows info on enemies not targeting you. +50% amplified headshot/weakpoint damage vs them. Headshot kills reset the Decoy cooldown.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Marksman Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Nemesis
exotics.summary: Charge shot: deals 0-100% weapon damage depending on how long the trigger is held.
exotics.obtain: Complete its exotic quest to get your first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Marksman Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Dread Edict
exotics.summary: Hits build up to 20 stacks (headshots 2) of +2% WD & +5% HSD. Reloading converts stacks into temp armor. Headshot kills refill the magazine.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Marksman Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Sacrum Imperium
exotics.summary: Tags up to 10 enemies in your crosshair. A headshot kill on a tagged target slows and burns the others for 10s (30s cooldown).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Marksman Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Shroud
exotics.summary: +125% Amplified Weapon Damage against the highest-ranking enemies in combat (tier hierarchy).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Marksman Rifle (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Prima Donna
exotics.talents: You can look... / ...but you can't touch
exotics.summary: Out of combat, gain 10 stacks of +12.5% Amplified Damage. A stack is consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you take; 1 stack regenerates every 3s.
exotics.obtain: Play the Paradise Lost Incursion weekly on all your available characters (shares drops with Ouroboros)
exotics.blueprint: Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3.1)

exotics.name: Regulus
exotics.summary: Headshot kills create a 5m explosion dealing 400% weapon damage and applying Bleed.
exotics.obtain: Complete the Iron Horse raid weekly on all your available characters
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Tempest
exotics.summary: After your Shield breaks, the pistol becomes fully automatic and deals +25% Amplified Damage for 20s.
exotics.obtain: The Summit Floor 100 clear reward. Also available from rare exotic caches. Not a Master climax exclusive (Y7S2 Tidal Basin: The Pact Master guarantee is Blacklisters).
exotics.notes: Summit Floor 100 — not the Y7S2 Master exclusive

exotics.name: Liberty
exotics.summary: Hits grant +2% WD (max 30 stacks). Headshots consume the stacks to repair your shield 3% per stack.
exotics.obtain: Complete its exotic quest to get your first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Pistol (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Busy Little Bee
exotics.summary: Shots on different targets add stacks (max 10) of +20% Weapon Damage, which activate for 10s when you swap weapons.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Pistol (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Mosquito
exotics.summary: Hits add shared stacks. At 5, the enemy must target the last player who added a stack for 5s and takes +25% armor damage.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Pistol (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Whiplash
exotics.summary: Holstered 5s: reloads & primes. Swapping to it while primed reloads primary & secondary and grants +20% RPM, +50% WD until the mag is empty.
exotics.obtain: Y8 Season 1 (Rise Up) Manhunt Climax Mission (Pentagon: The Director). Guaranteed on 1st Master clear; can drop again on repeats
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Black Tusk Kill Squad (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)

exotics.name: Coyote's Mask
exotics.summary: You and allies gain crit bonuses based on distance to the last enemy hit: 0-15m +25% CHD; 15-25m +10% CHC/+10% CHD; 25m+ +25% CHC.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Mask (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Vile
exotics.summary: Status effects also apply a 10s DoT equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage, scaled by your status effect attributes.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Mask (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Tinkerer
exotics.summary: If primary & secondary are the same weapon type and not Exotic/Named, the secondary's talent also applies to the primary. Doesn't work with weapon-swap talents.
exotics.obtain: Y7 Season 1 (Crossroads) Manhunt Climax Mission (Potomac Event Center: The Manager). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)

exotics.name: Catharsis
exotics.summary: Taking damage builds Weapon Damage stacks (max 30). Taking damage at max purges stacks & status effects and drops a healing cloud for allies.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Mask (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Catalyst
exotics.summary: Dealing/receiving status effects builds up to 12 stacks of +2% WD & +2% Status Effects. At max stacks, status-affected kills grant +25% bonus armor & +20% reload speed for 5s. No ADS disruption while burning.
exotics.obtain: Final mission in the Battle for Brooklyn campaign or from named bosses in Brooklyn

exotics.name: Investor
exotics.summary: Bonuses per non-core attribute: red +10% CHD, yellow +5% Skill Efficiency, blue +1% Armor Regen. Any core attribute; 3rd random attribute instead of a mod slot.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Mask (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: True Sons Retaliation completion (Retaliation); Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)

exotics.name: Memento
exotics.summary: Kills drop trophies. Short buff scales with your core attributes; long buff +1% WD, +1% Skill Efficiency, +0.1% Armor Regen per trophy (5 min, max 30).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Backpack (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: NinjaBike Backpack
exotics.summary: Counts as an extra piece of your equipped sets to unlock their bonuses. Used as a brand-set cheat piece.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Backpack (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Birdie's Quick Fix
exotics.summary: +80% Revive Speed, -50% Weakened timer, +45% Hive efficiency, damage resistance while reviving. Revives grant +1 Skill Tier (Overcharge at ST6).
exotics.obtain: Y6 Season 3 (Burden of Truth) Manhunt Climax Mission (Roosevelt Island: Alani Kelso). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)

exotics.name: Acosta's Go-Bag
exotics.talents: One in Hand... Two in the Bag
exotics.summary: Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 Skill Tier for 15s (Overcharge at ST6, 60s cooldown). Also +1 armor kit, +3 grenades, +25% ammo capacity.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Backpack (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Harrier Pride
exotics.summary: Hits/kills build Red stacks (+0.5% WD); getting hit builds Blue stacks (+0.5% Damage Resistance). At 80 total stacks they convert into the opposite bonus until the next cap.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Backpack (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit). Was a 10th Anniversary Event Track reward

exotics.name: Sarru
exotics.summary: In combat the Moon cycles 8 phases every 5s, amplifying all your damage from 5% up to 25% (Full Moon) and back. A Decoy deployed at Full Moon gets Overcharge and pauses the cycle for 10s.
exotics.obtain: Red Moon Rising event (Sep 24 - Nov 3, 2026): random drop from the XB-35 "Phoebe" Marauder in the active PvE Dark Zone

exotics.name: Tardigrade
exotics.summary: When your or an ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s. 45s cooldown per ally; kills with your specialization weapon reset it.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Body Armor (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Provocator
exotics.summary: PvE: +25% Damage Resistance against enemies within 20m (PvP: +20% within 15m).
exotics.obtain: Y6 Season 2 (Shades of Red) Manhunt Climax Mission (Space Administration HQ: Theo Parnell). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)

exotics.name: Ridgeway's Pride
exotics.summary: Shooting enemies within 15m applies Bleed. Repairs 3-48% armor/s, scaling with the number of bleeding enemies within 15m.
exotics.obtain: Complete Summit exotic quest to get first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Body Armor (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Beacon
exotics.summary: You & allies within 10m: +30% CHD, +15% Skill Efficiency, +2% Armor Regen. Smaller bonus when one of your skills is within 10m.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Body Armor (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Collector
exotics.summary: +3 grenade capacity, +50% grenade radius, +35% grenade damage (+25% per extra enemy hit). Regenerates a grenade every 30s if you hold fewer than 2.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Body Armor (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Iron Will
exotics.summary: Your next body shot counts as a headshot. Cooldown 2s PvE / 3s PvP. Requires MMR, Rifle or Pistol. Replaces the old Determined chaining.
exotics.obtain: Y8S3 Red Horizon Season Pass (free track; wiki says Tier 29)
exotics.targeted: Not yet (Y8S3 Season Pass; expected in loot pool after season)

exotics.name: BTSU Datagloves
exotics.summary: +15% Hive skill haste per Skill Tier. Detonating a Hive refreshes skill cooldowns and grants Overcharge for 15s (also allies at ST6).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Gloves (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Bloody Knuckles
exotics.summary: Grenade damage or melee hits trigger Seeing Red: +25% WD and +100% melee damage for 20s (60s cooldown, which melee/grenade hits complete instantly).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Gloves (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Overdogs
exotics.summary: +30% Amplified Weapon Damage against the lowest-ranking enemies (tier hierarchy).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Gloves (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Exodus
exotics.summary: When your armor breaks, drops a Smoke Bomb at your feet that briefly conceals you from enemies (40s cooldown) [verify].
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Gloves (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Rugged Gauntlets
exotics.summary: -50% recoil penalty when hip-firing and when blind-firing from cover.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Gloves (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Dodge City Gunslinger's Holster
exotics.summary: While your pistol is holstered, gain a stack every 0.3s (max 100). The first shot after swapping deals +10% damage per stack and counts as a headshot. Requires pistol.
exotics.obtain: Complete its exotic quest to get your first. Additional copies from targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)
exotics.blueprint: Yes: craft from exotic components + blueprint (quest)

exotics.name: Waveform
exotics.summary: +3% Skill Damage stack per second on one skill (max 10). After 10s at cap, the stacks move to your other skill.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Shocker Punch
exotics.summary: -50% Shock stun on you. With a shield: +100% melee damage. With St. Elmo's: +100% melee damage and the next melee applies Shock (5m AoE with all three). 15s cooldown.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Centurion's Scabbard
exotics.summary: Weapon swaps cycle bonuses: (1) +20% RPM & +20% WD, (2) +50% Mag Size & +50% Reload Speed. Lasts 12s or until the next swap. Sidearm swaps don't advance it.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Imperial Dynasty
exotics.summary: In combat, applies Burn to the closest enemy within 20m (35s cooldown).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Nimble
exotics.summary: PvE: 5% armor repair per 1m of cover-to-cover movement. Damage taken during cover-to-cover is healed over 10s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Holster (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Blacklisters
exotics.summary: Shooting marks one enemy (15s). +20% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies, but you take +600% Amplified Damage from the marked one. The mark drops when only one enemy remains.
exotics.obtain: Y7 Season 2 (The Pact) Manhunt Climax Mission (Tidal Basin: The Pact). Guaranteed drop on the 1st clear on Master difficulty
exotics.targeted: No (Climax exclusive; also in rare-exotic cache pools)

exotics.name: Acosta's Kneepads
exotics.summary: Vaulting/climbing/dropping and being hit by status effects grant short Movement Speed boosts (max +20%).
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Kneepads (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Sawyer's Kneepads
exotics.summary: Can't be staggered by explosions. +3% damage per second standing still (max 10 stacks); stacks lost 10s after moving.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Kneepads (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: NinjaBike Kneepads
exotics.summary: Cover-to-cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Kneepads (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit)

exotics.name: Nurse's Kneepads
exotics.summary: You and allies within 10m get +40% Hazard Protection.
exotics.obtain: Targeted loot: Kneepads (Countdown / Retaliation / Summit). Added to targeted loot in Y8S3; introduced in Y8S2 Into the Dark (season reward per LFCarry [verify])
exotics.targeted: Yes (added to targeted loot in Y8S3)
exotics.blueprint: Blueprint: Cleaners Kill Squad (Retaliation) [verify: wiki says Hyenas Retaliations]; Reconfigure blueprint at Inaya once owned (since Y8S3)

exotics.name: Loaded for Bear
exotics.summary: PTS text: hits apply stacks (max 20 per enemy); reloading consumes all stacks to deal 2% weapon damage per stack. Live values unconfirmed.
exotics.obtain: Y8S3 Red Horizon Manhunt Climax Mission (Loaded for Bear announced; exact climax mission not live as of Sep 28, 2026). Guaranteed on 1st Master clear per announcements once climax is live.
exotics.added: Y8S3 Red Horizon (Climax, not yet released)

exotics.name: The Ratel
exotics.summary: [unconfirmed] Talent and stats not revealed yet.
exotics.obtain: Echoes of Central Park paid DLC (launches Nov 3, 2026; $19.99): earned from Central Park content [unconfirmed details]
